svg.title: The Peal: Repoussé gold
svg.desc: The Peal (1D): a sheet of gold worked in repousse, hammered up from behind. Along the top six bells rise as domed bosses, each numbered by punched dots. Below them the rows of a touch are chased into the gold line by line, rounds first (123456), and the path of one bell through the rows is raised as a ridge, as change ringers draw a method's line. Each row may only swap neighbours, and no row may come twice; a row marked with a struck punch is the one where the next call goes. A striped woollen sally hangs at the side. The whole surface carries small hammer marks.
svg.text: only neighbours change; no row twice; home to rounds
